summary: ACV Auctions Inc., a Delaware-incorporated online wholesale vehicle auctioneer listed on the NYSE under ACVA, filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated September 10, 2026 with Copart, Inc. and its wholly owned subsidiary Apple Merger Sub, Inc. Copart will cause Merger Sub to commence a cash tender offer for all outstanding ACV common stock at $10.50 per share, net in cash. The offer must commence within seven business days and remain open at least 10 business days. Closing conditions include a majority-of-shares minimum tender condition, HSR antitrust clearance, and no injunctive prohibition. The transaction is structured as a Section 251(h) two-step merger, with no financing condition and no additional stockholder vote required.
